request.subject: PORTRAIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Remove the round wooden shield completely. His helmet becomes a closed steel great helm that hides the whole face: a rounded bucket helm with a dark eye slit and a gold cross on its front, the crimson crest kept on top. Polished steel plate with a big round pauldron rimmed in gold over the crimson tabard with the gold cross. The sword becomes a huge greatsword with a broad blade and gold crossguard. Keep proportions, black outline and style the same, transparent background.
